name: Dependabot Auto-Merge
on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Only CI/CT"]
    types: [completed]

jobs:
  dependabot-auto-merge:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Fetch Dependabot metadata
        id: metadata
        uses: dependabot/fetch-metadata@v2
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' }}
        with:
          github-token: "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"

      - name: Check if PR is from Dependabot
        id: check_dependabot
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}" != "dependabot[bot]" ]]; then
            echo "Not a Dependabot PR"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Wait for workflow_run completion
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' }}
        run: |
          sleep 5

      - name: Validate CI Status
        id: validate_ci
        run: |
          # Get the PR number from the workflow run context
          PR_NUMBER=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}" | \
            jq -r '.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number')
          
          if [[ -z "$PR_NUMBER" || "$PR_NUMBER" == "null" ]]; then
            echo "No PR number found in workflow run"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Get combined status
          STATUS=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/commits/${{ github.sha }}/status" | \
            jq -r '.state')
          
          # Get check runs
          CHECK_RUNS=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/commits/${{ github.sha }}/check-runs?per_page=100" | \
            jq -r '.check_runs[] | .conclusion')
          
          HAS_VALIDATION=false
          FAILED_CHECK=false
          
          # Check if there are any check runs
          if [[ ! -z "$CHECK_RUNS" && "$CHECK_RUNS" != "" ]]; then
            HAS_VALIDATION=true
            
            # Check for failed or cancelled checks
            for run in $CHECK_RUNS; do
              if [[ "$run" == "failure" || "$run" == "cancelled" ]]; then
                FAILED_CHECK=true
                break
              fi
            done
          fi
          
          echo "has_validation=$HAS_VALIDATION" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "failed_check=$FAILED_CHECK" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "pr_number=$PR_NUMBER" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Approve and Merge PR
        if: ${{ env.has_validation == 'true' && env.failed_check == 'false' && github.event_name == 'workflow_run' }}
        uses: peter-evans/enable-pull-request-automerge@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          pull-request-number: ${{ env.pr_number }}
          merge-method: "squash"
